_doc: Milestones: the playable end-to-end units of this game (kit.config.json milestoneWord names them: level, mission, stage, quest, run). Each phase in backlog.json lists its milestones ids. A milestone is playable by the harness once harness/verify/milestones/<ID>.js plays it start to finish through window.__game.debug (no position writes, real inputs only). required: false marks an optional one, counted once it has a play script. budgetMs is the play script's time budget. 'act' and 'order' give the story position (STORY_SEED.md, GAME.md 'Structure' and 'Act 1: Sawari'); 'slice': true marks the first playable slice, M01 to M04 (four SOLO missions, no merge, GAME.md 'First playable slice'). M05 to M10 are the rest of Act 1 (phase P5), not required until their phase is planned. M11 to M67 are the planned missions of Acts 2 to 5 from STORY_OUTLINE.md (phases P9, P10, P12 and P13): optional entries with a short summary; the planner of each act's phase writes their beats and sets required true. Phases and their milestones are in harness/state/backlog.json (game plan P0-023). Story details (names, lines) come from the content writer and may change, the beats and checks stay.

milestones.title: Free drive (scaffold)
milestones.summary: Scaffold free drive: boot, drive the box car north along the road strip for 100 m with real inputs, turn right toward east, stop. Proves the input, sim clock and coordinate rule end to end. Replaced by the real free drive once the world exists; optional so it never blocks a gate.

milestones.title: Train at 6:10 (Driver)
districts: D07 (New Delhi station forecourt, Ajmeri Gate side: pilot gap, see GAME.md)
milestones.summary: First mission of the game; the auto driver leads. 1. Start at an auto stand near Chandni Chowk in a hot hazy afternoon; goal line 'Pick up the family' and a marker within 5 s. 2. Drive to the hail and stop beside the family; they board with luggage (passenger lines). 3. Goal 'New Delhi station before 6:10' with a timer; the main road is jammed, a gali shortcut is marked as the second route. 4. Drive with gap weaving and the horn through traffic to the station drop-off; no on-foot part. 5. Drop off: the family leave; a second passenger, a nervous man with no luggage, hails, rides toward CP and gets out in a hurry, leaving a bag in the auto: cash and a diary (a short story beat, STORY_SEED.md hook). 6. Completion screen: fare money, time against the best, the bag and the diary as the hook. Fails: timer runs out ('The train left'), the auto is wrecked, the family is thrown out by a crash; each shows its reason and retries from the last checkpoint. Must show: the gali shortcut and the main road both drivable, near misses, horn reaction.

milestones.title: Who wants the bag (Driver)
milestones.summary: The driver's second mission, same night as M01. Cameo: the cop. 1. Start in the auto at CP with the bag under the seat; goal line 'Get away from the men following you' within 5 s. A dark car of two men chases (they want the bag; the first passenger is already dead, told by the radio or a crowd). 2. Chase through the CP circles and out toward Barakhamba Road: gap weaving and the horn, two routes (the main road, or the service lane behind the blocks). 3. A police jeep joins from a side road; SI Meera Rana is at the wheel for a few seconds (cameo, she is introduced here, not playable). She notes the auto number and gives chase half-heartedly; the driver loses both in the galis near Connaught Place or Janpath. 4. Hide-out: stop in a quiet lane, look in the bag (the diary, torn pages, three missing), goal 'Hide the bag'. 5. Completion screen: fare money, time against the best, the dead passenger and the cop jeep as the hook. Fails: caught by the dark car for 8 s ('They got you'), the auto is wrecked, the police pin the auto ('The police stopped you'); each with its reason and a checkpoint retry. Must show: the two routes, near misses, the jeep cameo framed so Meera is recognisable later.

milestones.title: Barricade at ITO (Cop)
milestones.summary: The cop's first mission. 1. Start at the police station near ITO; this is Meera's first mission and the dead passenger from M02 is her case; a radio call: the dark getaway car (stolen) is fleeing from CP; goal line 'Stop the stolen car' and a marker within 5 s. 2. Get in the patrol car and catch up with the suspect on the road from CP toward ITO. 3. Pursuit over the ITO flyovers: the suspect weaves through traffic; the goal prompts 'Call a barricade' and the player calls one at the next junction ahead (B). 4. The suspect crashes at the barricade and fires from behind the car: a short standoff and exchange of fire with the pistol (soft lock-on), then he runs on foot. 5. Foot chase a short way; melee hits stagger the suspect, a takedown downs him, the player holds the arrest. 6. A clue in the car points at the bag's auto (she has its number from the jeep) and at a fixer's name in Chandni Chowk (story hook). Meera meets ACP Khanna on the radio, a warm voice (he is later in the diary). Completion screen: case reward, pursuit time against the best. Fails: the suspect gets away (distance over 300 m for 10 s: 'He got away'), a civilian is killed, the patrol car is wrecked; each with its reason and a checkpoint retry. Must show: the flyover split, the barricade at a real junction, the standoff, the takedown.

milestones.title: Chandni Chowk pickup (Fixer)
milestones.summary: The fixer's first playable mission in the slice; Danny is introduced here (he is named in M03's clue); hired by a client to get the bag back. 1. Start on foot in a Chandni Chowk lane; goal line 'Collect the package' and a marker within 5 s. 2. Walk through the bazaar crowd (30 to 60 people) to the contact's shop; the courier who was to hand over the bag is dead and the bag is missing (ties to M01 and M02); the shopkeeper gives him one lead, an auto number. 3. A rival crew jumps the fixer in the lane: a fistfight with 3 melee thugs (combo, block, dodge, one takedown). 4. Police whistles: wanted level 1 starts. 5. Get on the scooter and escape through the galis or the main road (two routes) and lose the wanted level (leave the search circle, stay unseen 15 s). 6. Completion screen: payment, escape time against the best, the auto number and the hunt for the bag as the hook. Fails: the fixer is downed ('You were beaten'), busted ('The police got you'); each with its reason and a checkpoint retry. Must show: dense crowd that parts and flees, the fight, wanted 1 and its escape.

milestones.title: Lead to the Chowk (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera follows the M03 clue into Chandni Chowk. 1. Patrol bike from ITO to the bazaar edge, then on foot in the crowd. 2. Find the witness at a shop (talk, no combat). 3. A man tails her; a tail chase through the galis, then a short foot chase and takedown. 4. She hears the name Danny from a frightened shopkeeper (the fixer is now on her map). Completion: case progress, the name, a warning from Khanna. Fails: the witness is lost, the tail escapes, a civilian is hurt.

milestones.title: First favour (Fixer, past story)
milestones.summary: A short playable flashback of Danny years ago, shown with a graded look (sepia and warm grain). He is young and takes his first job for a boss: carry a sealed package across the Chowk and never ask what is inside. Reuses built places (lanes, the Old Delhi roofs). Teaches the fixer verbs in a safe setting (crowd slipping, a tail, one fight). Plants Danny's rule 'never ask what is inside'. No reveal of the fire; that is Act 4. About 6 to 8 minutes. Fails: dropped package, caught by the boss's rival.

milestones.title: Wrong auto (Fixer, crossing)
milestones.summary: The crossing and first meeting of the three. 1. Danny, with the auto number from M04, searches the station stands and finds Bittu. 2. A tense talk by the auto; Bittu denies it. 3. Meera arrives in a patrol car (she traced the number too). A stand-off in the forecourt: Danny talks his way out, Bittu is questioned, none of them says what they know. 4. Danny slips away on foot or scooter through the station crowd; the cop and the driver both see his face. Completion: the three now know of each other. Fails: Danny is caught, a bystander is hurt, Bittu bolts too early.

milestones.title: Nowhere to hide (Driver)
milestones.summary: The driver's fallout. Bittu takes the bag to an elder at the auto stand for advice; the crew follows. The elder is shoved around and Bittu drives him out through the galis and back streets (two routes). A first taste of the story: he cannot stay out of it, and a torn page is found. Completion: the first missing page clue and the first step in his arc. Fails: the elder is hurt in a crash, the auto is wrecked, the crew boxes him in.

milestones.title: Khanna says drop it (Cop)
milestones.summary: The cop's fallout. ACP Khanna, warm and fatherly, warns Meera off the case at a chai stall near ITO. She does not drop it. 1. A night tail of the crew's car from ITO toward Old Delhi in a patrol car, lights off. 2. A short foot approach. 3. She overhears the crew's meeting spot: Red Fort parking. Completion: the setup for the finale and a first doubt that she keeps to herself. Fails: spotted too early, the tail is lost, a civilian is hurt.

milestones.title: Red Fort rush (merged finale)
milestones.summary: The Act 1 finale and the first merged mission: the first use of switching. 1. Start as Bittu near Red Fort with the bag; a crew car chases. 2. Driver getaway through Netaji Subhas Marg traffic toward the Red Fort parking. 3. Switch at the beat (T) to Danny, who arrives in the parking lot: a pistol fight against 3 or 4 thugs with soft lock-on. 4. Switch at the beat to Meera, who tailed the crew: the leader flees by car; a chase ending in a barricade or a ram and an arrest. 5. The three meet and stand off at Red Fort; a call comes: 'Gurugram mein milte hain.' Completion: rewards for all three, the story turn. Fails: any lead downed or busted, the leader escapes, the bag is lost; each with its reason and a checkpoint retry. Must show: two switches under 2 s each, a pistol fight, Red Fort in a first-sight shot.

milestones.title: Ghar (Driver)
milestones.summary: Laxmi Nagar. Amma, Sonu, dinner, a TV serial. Bhola's men are at the Metro pillar. A chase under the Blue Line with Sonu riding pillion. Back home, Amma's hospital card: Sethi Seva Trust. Bittu looks at "H.S." in the ledger. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Paper trail (Cop)
milestones.summary: Khanna puts Meera on desk duty. She takes the munshi's phone to Ira Bose, who traces the last call to a Gurugram tower. First drive to Gurugram at night: the glass city opens up. A courier on a bike sees her and runs: pursuit on the expressway. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Madam (Fixer)
milestones.summary: A Cyber City rooftop bar. Danny's client hands over through Kabir Sethi, all charm and nerves. Madam on the phone: double the fee for the ledger. Bhola's men are in the bar too. A fight down the parking ramps. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Daryaganj Sunday (Driver)
milestones.summary: The book market. Bittu searches stalls with Rafiq's hint while Bhola's men search too. A chase through the stalls and Daryaganj lanes. The mission ends with the stall owner saying, "Ek panna? Haan, kisi ne bechne ko diya tha." The page itself is optional (Page 1 hunt, section 9). Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: GB Road raid (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera raids traffickers above the hardware shops, chasing the munshi's last night. She clears the stairs, gets the people held there out safe, and finds Rani, who knew him. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: GB Road money (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny deals with the money men who run the street. Their ledger shows a cut going to Bhola every month and donations to the Seva Trust. He takes the ledger page by charm, then by a fight. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Way out (Driver)
milestones.summary: Rani wants out of the city. Bittu drives her toward ISBT Kashmere Gate with the kotha's men on his tail. At the bus bay she freezes: they are waiting. He takes her home to Amma instead. In the auto she shows him the munshi's two tickets: 6:10 morning train. "Babu kehta tha, kitaab radio wale ko deni hai." Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Teen patti (Fixer, crossing at ISBT)
milestones.summary: Danny calls a meeting at the ISBT at midnight. Bittu, Meera, Danny, each with one piece: the ledger, the phone, the cash. A forced alliance. Bhola ambushes them in the bus bays; a crossing escape where the other two act as NPCs. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Gymkhana favour (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny gets into Delhi Gymkhana as Kabir's guest. He plants a recorder in Sethi's lounge and hears Sethi call someone "M-sahab". A rich member wants a favour done quietly; Danny does it and learns who funds the gala. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Free surgery (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera meets Tara at the Seva hospital. The billing: one surgery, three government claims. Rawat appears for the first time and warns her off. A fake ambulance moving cash leaves the back gate; chase through South Delhi to the Gurugram toll. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Delivery partner (Driver)
milestones.summary: Sonu knows Tower 9 at Cyber Hub: he delivers biryani to the basement guards at 2 am. Bittu drives Sonu's route in his auto, a yellow-green speck on the expressway. Recon of the basement ramps and the water tanker bay. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Charity gala (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera works security at Sethi's gala under Khanna's eye. Sethi announces Dilli 2040 and his run for CM. He meets Meera and says, "Tumhare papa achhe aadmi the." She did not know he knew him. Danny is inside as Kabir's guest; they exchange one look. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Paani (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny steals a water tanker from the tanker mafia that supplies the towers: the only truck the tower never searches. A chase through Gurugram's unfinished sectors. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Tower heist (merged peak, all three)
milestones.summary: Bittu drives the tanker into the basement. Danny cuts into the counting room. Meera walks into the control room with a fake inspection order. They take the hard drive and the cash. In the vault: Kabir, waiting. "I hired the munshi. I wanted my father finished. Then I talked too much." Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 2); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Chai pe charcha (Driver)
milestones.summary: Khanna offers a deal: return the ledger, keep the cash, family safe. Bittu says yes. He drives Khanna back to ITO in his auto. Khanna talks about Bittu's father by name, fondly. Bittu never told him the name. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Undercover ride (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera rides in the back of Bittu's auto under a dupatta, tailing Khanna from Khan Market to Vasant Kunj. Khanna gets into Bhola's car. Betrayal, seen with her own eyes. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Farmhouse (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Madam sends Danny into Khanna's Vasant Kunj farmhouse for his copy of the fire file. Dogs, guards, a pool party. He finds the file on HC Balwant Rana: dismissed for a planted bribe. And an old photo: Jaggi, Khanna and young Bhola outside a godown. Danny pockets both. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Delivery killer (Driver)
milestones.summary: Sonu is arrested live on NewsTez 24. Rocky Sabharwal calls him the "delivery killer". Bittu chases the police van across the Yamuna bridge. Sonu calls from the van: "Bhaiya, mat karo. Amma." The mission cannot be won. It ends with Bittu stopping. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Media trial (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny gets into the NewsTez studio in Okhla. The "confession" is a stitched edit. He steals the raw file. Chase out through the studio lot and the Nizamuddin flyovers. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Platform 6 (Cop)
milestones.summary: At Nizamuddin railway station Meera finds the CCTV from the murder night: Gullu, not Sonu. Rawat's team arrives first. Foot chase over parked trains and across the yard. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Haunted night (Cop)
milestones.summary: Gullu is hiding at Malcha Mahal. Winter fog. Meera goes alone. A woman in an old shawl is sitting on the steps. She says, "Tera baap darwaza kholna chahta tha." Then she is gone. Meera finds Gullu inside, shaking. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Encounter (Cop, THE choice)
milestones.summary: Khanna's "last test". Meera joins Rawat's team to bring Gullu in. 3 am, a dark stretch of the Mehrauli-Gurgaon road. Gullu is cuffed. Rawat hands her the pistol: "Bhaaga tha. Goli chalani padi." The truth: Gullu really did kill the munshi. If he dies "in an encounter", the case closes and Sonu walks free. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Inspector Rana / Wanted: Rana (Cop, two versions)
milestones.summary: Shoot: a promotion ceremony at police HQ, flashbulbs, Khanna's hand on her shoulder. Then her first job in his circle: clear an evidence room. She uses it to copy the fire file index. Refuse: Rawat's team hunts her through Mehrauli at dawn. The player drives a police car with police stars against her. She escapes on foot into the ruins. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Hadtaal (Driver)
milestones.summary: Sethi's money turns the auto union against Bittu. Drivers strike, a stand closes him out. Rafiq stands by him. Sethi's men seal Amma's house. Bittu drives Amma and Rani out of Laxmi Nagar to Rafiq's cousin's place in the Yamuna floodplain. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Kabir's run (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Kabir wants out to London with a copy of the hard drive. Danny drives him down NH-48 to the airport, Bhola's crew on them. Kabir tells him: his father never ordered the munshi's death. Khanna did. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Aerocity (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Madam pays Danny with a Dubai ticket and a hotel key in Aerocity. The room is a trap: Bhola's men. A hotel fight down the service stairs. Danny keeps the ticket anyway. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Ramphal (Cop)
milestones.summary: Ramphal drives Meera toward the airport and confesses: he has been telling Khanna everything. He did it for his daughter's posting. Rawat's cars appear. Forgive or report him (section 7). Either way he drives through the barricade for her. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Runway (merged peak, all three)
milestones.summary: Danny is on the Dubai plane. Bittu drives an airport tug across the apron to stop Bhola's men from reaching the stairs. Meera chases Rawat down the perimeter road. Kabir's flight leaves. Danny's door closes, and he walks off the plane before it moves: someone gets on a plane, someone does not. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 3); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Bela (Driver)
milestones.summary: Life in the basti. Rafiq's cousin, kids flying kites, a vegetable farmer on the floodplain. Bittu runs an e-rickshaw for basti families to Shahdara market and back. Demolition notices go up; a dirt-track chase on the river bed against Sethi's survey jeep. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Den (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera (Inspector or suspended) raids an East Delhi den where Bhola stashes the munshi's laptop. Shootout on the stairs and rooftops. The den is shown honestly: sick young men, nobody glamorous. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Chacha (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny visits Jaggi on oxygen in Paharganj. Jaggi wanders between now and then: "Darwaza band kiya tha na? Shabaash." In his room, Danny takes the dented tiffin off the shelf and turns it over. It says "Ramesh". He sits down. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: The fire night (Fixer flashback, playable)
milestones.summary: Sepia again. 5 October, night. The second half of M06. Bhola sends the chowkidar away. He gives boy Danny the padlock: "Andar maal hai. Band kar." The player has to lock the door to go on. Knocking from inside. The player walks away; the knocking follows. Smoke. Boy Danny runs into the morning crowd. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Settlement (Driver)
milestones.summary: Amma's dialysis at the Seva hospital in Noida. Tara is her nurse. A chase on the Noida expressway when Rawat's men spot the auto. In the hospital bed, Amma tells him: she signed. ₹2 lakh and a promise of care, for no case. "Tum do bachche the. Main kya karti?" Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Malcha (Driver)
milestones.summary: A night fare: a woman in a shawl hails him on the ridge road and asks for "Kucha Gulab Rai". He turns, she is gone; old banknotes on the seat, from fifteen years ago. He drives back to Malcha Mahal. She is on the steps and calls him "Bittu", the name only family used. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Maa (Cop)
milestones.summary: Meera goes home. Malti Rana's trunk: her father's original fire report, in his handwriting. "Darwaza bahar se band tha. Ek ladka bhaaga, terah saal ka, Jaggi ka ladka." Malti: "Maine stamp lagaya tha. Main woh nahi hoon jo tum dhoondh rahi ho." She will not say more. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Bulldozers (merged, converge)
milestones.summary: Dawn. Sethi's bulldozers and police at the Bela basti. Meera is on the police line (Inspector) or hiding in the crowd (suspended), the report in her pocket. Bittu drives families and their things out of the bulldozers' path. Danny forges a court stay and races it through Shahdara traffic. The stay arrives for half the basti. Half falls. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Gullu ki Maa / The witness (Cop, two versions)
milestones.summary: Shoot path: Gullu's mother lives in the basti. Her house was one that fell. Meera drives her to a shelter. She does not know who Meera is. She talks about her son the whole way. Refuse path: Gullu, alive, hiding in the basti, is Rawat's target. Meera moves him through Shahdara under fire. He agrees to testify. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Records (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny and Tara steal the Seva hospital's real billing records in Noida. Tara has to choose between her scholarship and the truth; she chooses the truth and loses her job on the spot. A getaway from hospital security. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Rawat (Cop)
milestones.summary: Rawat corners Meera in the Shahdara rail yard. A boss fight across wagons. Rawat ends arrested (Refuse path, Gullu's testimony makes it stick) or dead (Shoot path, he draws first and she is faster now). Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Loha Pul (Driver, THE second choice)
milestones.summary: Meera tells Bittu what her father's report says. Bittu finds Danny in Paharganj and chases him across the Yamuna bridges. Danny does not fight back. They end on the Old Iron bridge at night, a train going over them. Danny gives him the tiffin. The quiet scene: forgive or not (section 7). Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Jaggi's end (Fixer)
milestones.summary: Danny goes back to Jaggi. On his last breath Jaggi says: "Sethi ne paisa diya. Khanna ne case band kiya. Aur upar se haan aayi thi." Who said yes? "M." Jaggi dies. Bhola's men come; a fight through the Paharganj lanes. If forgiven, Bittu's auto arrives to get him out; if not, Danny escapes alone on foot. Planned from STORY_OUTLINE.md (Act 4); the beats, fails and checks are written when the act's phase is planned, and the entry becomes required then.

milestones.title: Kaala Paani (merged peak, all three)
milestones.summary: Core Delhi is being sealed for election day. The three must cross the Yamuna back into it at night. Bittu on a fisherman's boat, Danny on the Old Iron bridge rail track, Meera down the river road in a stolen police boat. A river chase under the bridges. milestones.title: Chakka jam (Driver)
